nameEn: Manufacture of other chemical products n.e.c.
description: This class includes the manufacture of a variety of chemical products not elsewhere classified.
includes: manufacture of photographic plates, films, sensitized paper and other sensitized unexposed materials
manufacture of photographic chemicals (developers, fixers etc.)
manufacture of gelatin and its derivatives
manufacture of writing and drawing ink
manufacture of pyrotechnic products: fireworks, signal flares, rain rockets, fog signals etc.
manufacture of chemical preparations for photographic uses
manufacture of fatty acids, waxes and amines from oils and fats
manufacture of activated carbon, lubricating oil additives, composite solvents and thinners, drawing ink, stencil correcting fluid and other chemical products
excludes: manufacture of separately chemically defined compounds in bulk, see 2011-2013
